verdict.rationale: Docs confirm inline citations for grounded chat responses, hover-to-preview quoted text, and click-to-navigate directly to the source location for verification — the core of the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of citation accuracy and coverage across all generated formats (e.g., whether audio/video overviews also carry citations), and no third-party audit of citation completeness for 'every substantive claim'.
